login.title: Sign in to Porto
login.description: Enter your credentials to open the panel.

totpStep.title: Two-step verification
totpStep.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.description: Enter your account email: we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If the address is registered, you will shortly receive an email with instructions.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.inviteDescription: Choose a password to activate your account.
reset.description: Choose a new password of at least 12 characters.
reset.done: Password updated. You can now sign in.
reset.missingToken: The link has no valid code. Request a new link.

totpSetup.title: Enable two-step verification
totpSetup.description: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the generated code.
totpSetup.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
totpSetup.recoveryDescription: Each code works once, if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.

account.title: My account
account.name: Name
account.disableDescription: Confirm with your password and an app code.
account.regenerateDescription: The previous codes will stop working.
